source: She has never published a price for the infusion side - her words are 'I can infuse your food for an additional price'. Every number here is a Philadelphia going rate we set, NOT hers. All of it needs her sign-off. The 'Shroom' items from her deleted 2021 dessert menu are deliberately absent - see research/menu-extracted.md section 4.

sections.title: The Add-On
sections.heading: It is an add-on, not a separate kitchen
sections.note: She makes her own infused butter and cooks with it, so most of The Kitchen menu can be made infused. Strength is set per order - tell her what you are used to and she will match it.

items.name: Any Dish, Infused
items.desc: Add to any plate on The Kitchen menu. Price is on top of the dish. Tell her the strength you want.

items.name: Infused Butter
items.desc: The base she cooks with, by the jar. She makes it herself.
